TABLE.NAME: edpreset
TABLE.COMMENT: Stub instance table. This module is never instantiated - it exists only as an activity chooser content-item provider. The table is required because core queries {modulename} unconditionally: course/reset_form.php does an UNCAUGHT count_records($modname, ...) for every installed module, so without this table /course/reset.php would fail site-wide.

TABLE.NAME: edpreset_item
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per exemplar activity in the template course. Rows are upserted on templatecmid so preset ids stay stable across rebuilds - user favourites and recommendations key on this id.

FIELD.NAME: templatecmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Natural key. Rows are upserted on this to keep preset ids stable.

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Exemplar module context. Used to match the restore task and as the source for file copies.

FIELD.NAME: help
FIELD.COMMENT: Cleaned HTML shown in the chooser info panel. Exported as PARAM_RAW by core, so it MUST be format_text()ed before it is stored here.

FIELD.NAME: icon
FIELD.COMMENT: pix icon name. The component is always mod_<modname>. Rendered HTML is deliberately not stored.

FIELD.NAME: archetype
FIELD.COMMENT: MOD_ARCHETYPE_* of the exemplar - decides the chooser tab

FIELD.NAME: purpose
FIELD.COMMENT: MOD_PURPOSE_* of the exemplar - decides the icon colour

FIELD.NAME: category
FIELD.COMMENT: Section name of the exemplar in the template course

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: sectionnum * 1000 + position. The chooser re-sorts by title, so this is for the manage page.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending|baking|validating|ready|failed. Describes the pipeline; chooser visibility is decided by the live backup file, not by this.

FIELD.NAME: datescleared
FIELD.COMMENT: What the scrubber changed, for curator visibility on the manage page

FIELD.NAME: scrubbed
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the live archive is the scrubbed version or the unscrubbed fallback

FIELD.NAME: backupcontenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: contenthash of the live .mbz, verified before every restore
